legend: Typical histology of MYCN-amplified neuroblastoma with a high mitosis-karyorrhexis index.
Plain axial CT image shows a hypodense mass in the left adrenal region. There are internal amorphous/mottled calcifications.
Contrast-enhanced axial CT image shows a heterogeneously enhancing tumour with non-enhancing components suggestive of tumour necrosis. There is compression and anterior displacement of the pancreas.

Contrast-enhanced axial CT image shows an irregularly shaped, poorly enhancing retroperitoneal mass crossing the midline and with characteristic vascular encasement of the abdominal aorta and its branches including the superior mesenteric artery and bilateral renal arteries. Both kidneys are compressed and displaced laterally. There are also diffuse liver metastases.
